title: Proposal
description: A request, usually from the planner, to execute one action with concrete params. It carries the context it was derived from, with origins, so the gate can tell user intent from instructions found in data.

session_id.description: Session the proposal belongs to; sessions never see each other's state.

plan_id.description: Plan this proposal is a step of.

params.description: Parameters; validated against the action's params schema by the gate.

rationale.description: Why the proposer wants this; shown to approvers.

context.description: Context items the proposal was derived from, each with its origin.

ref.description: Pointer to the item (message id, document chunk, tool call).

triggered.description: True for the single item that prompted the proposal.
